name: Life with basil: The girl who i always been with.
source: A boy named Ren awakens in a beautiful, blank white world beside a girl who never leaves his side. As the world begins to unravel, he realizes they are trapped within the remains of a tragedy he can no longer remember.
translation: 名叫莲（Ren）的少年在一个美丽而纯白的空白世界中醒来，身旁陪伴着一位寸步不离的少女。随着这个世界开始分崩离析，他渐渐意识到，两人正被困在一场自己早已遗忘的惨剧残骸之中。
